I like your idea of providing two perspectives on the issue (though it might be best to put the second in a comment to consolidate discussion).

On the topic itself, I'll be interested to see how Tsipras' fight with the EU goes over the next several months. Personally, I suspect that he indeed made a lot of political promises during his campaign that he now finds himself unable to keep. Of the two views you've provided, I think that the second will turn out to be closer to the truth, as the mere "buying time" that the first article discussed will be either repeated or solidified. Tsipras has given some ground to the EU here, which will embolden Germany et al. to insist on terms just as strong or stronger six months from now. He has agreed in principle to EU oversight of the Greek economy, which I think will come back to bite him later on.

I think the jury is out on this one. Wsws.org jumped the gun and was--as it often is--overly harsh. It could very well prove to be correct, but I'm still waiting for more.

Anyway, it's kind of slow with posting in here, at least for now. I wanted to give each post an equal chance.

The jury is undoubtedly out, though I think he's shown a sign of weakness. Germany forced him to back down at least temporarily, and has every incentive to keep pushing. If Greece can successfully get out of even some of its loan obligations, that will weaken the German grip on the rest of the EU, which is the last thing it wants.

Not strictly related to jabberpals, but if you want to also use pidgin to connect to the voat IRC here is how:

  • Select Accounts > Add/Edit

  • Click Add

  • Drop-down select Protocol: IRC

  • Type the screen name you wish to use as Screen Name

  • Ensure that the Server: irc.freenode.net is specified.

  • The Password: leave blank.

  • Save

To auto join #VOAT on login

  • Right Click Buddies > Select Add Chat

  • In Account chose username@irc.freenode.net (IRC)

  • In channel type #VOAT

  • In Group chose which group you want it to be a part of

The autojoin checkbox will automatically start up the chatroom evertime you start Pidgin, Otherwise you have to select it from the buddies list when you want to chat
